scope: PyTorch 2.10 CPU aot_function 默认 partition_fn；真实捕获 FX 图并执行，不运行 Inductor 或 min-cut 性能实验。

sources.title: Ansel et al., PyTorch 2: Faster Machine Learning Through Dynamic Python Bytecode Transformation and Graph Compilation
aot_function interface, joint trace and partition

claims.statement: AOTAutograd captures joint forward/backward graphs; functionalization and decomposition simplify graph representation, and partitioning separates forward and backward.
claims.limitation: Historical 2024 design and 2.10 API; exact transformation details depend on path and options.

claims.statement: aot_function defaults to default_partition; stashed tensors are forward outputs consumed by the backward graph. Min-cut rematerialization is a separate configurable policy.
claims.limitation: The example uses default partition, not a measured or executed min-cut policy.

claims.statement: For f(x)=sum(x*sin(x)), the captured forward FX returns sum, primal and sin; backward graph has primal, sin and tangent inputs. CPU gradient matches eager.
claims.limitation: Single fixed-shape real CPU example; callbacks return executable FX, not optimized machine code.

runs.environment: Python 3.13.5; torch 2.10.0+cpu; torch.version.git_version=449b1768410104d3ed79d3bcfe4ba1d65c7f22c0; Linux x86_64; OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; CUDA unavailable
